name: Érsekcsanád (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of three stripes, blue, green and blue, charged near the top of the green with the municipal arms of Érsekcsanád (a shield of blue and green with white flowers and a fish) above the name ÉRSEKCSANÁD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
